method: Pre-boot hook patches the game's module text so its pure state functions (WM step, GM doors/depart/new-service/time-of-day, FM constructor) are stepped headlessly at 1/60 s by a closed-loop controller; no rendering, no wall-clock time in the simulation.
inputsNote: Run-length script `<steps>x[ABRLP]/<pace>` (A accelerate, B brake, R reverse, L left, P right); one entry per 1/60 s step over all loops, doors/depart actions are in `events`.

repeatability.note: Each session is a fresh browser context; the simulation is a pure function of the inputs, so sessions are bit-identical.

memory.note: Headless state stepping allocates no renderer resources, so this is JS heap and simulation-state size only. Renderer memory (geometries, textures) is measured on the port, not the original.
memory.heapNote: performance.memory with --enable-precise-memory-info; it moves with GC (not monotonic across loops and differs between sessions), so it is recorded but not used as a pass/fail signal.
